cases.name: Robin Rebecca Noel Kern
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Having lost her adoptive mother at the age 11, she became a devoted and beloved mother of three young children. She persevered through the Scotts Valley and Santa Cruz school systems and trained to become a dental assistant. The effects of the pandemic shifted her focus to enable her to work from home. She trained and became a popular facial esthetician. She felt privileged to find success with her independent business. Robin had an effervescent personality and naturally lit up a room with her presence. She was ambitious honest, upfront and readily helped others when needed."
cases.caseStatus: PRISON PAROLEE / ON PROBATION; SUSPECT DECEASED
cases.narrative: Family members found her body in her apartment.
